svg.aria-label: i.MX 8M Plus boot chain: Boot ROM, U-Boot SPL, TF-A BL31, optional OP-TEE BL32, U-Boot proper BL33 and Linux, with where each runs, its privilege level, what it does, which file this repository builds for it, and which parts stay resident after Linux boots.
svg.text: How the i.MX 8M Plus boots, and what this repo builds for each stage
Power-on to login prompt: each stage loads the next, then either exits or stays resident to serve the next one.
STILL IN MEMORY WHILE LINUX RUNS
Boot ROM, SPL: finished, OCRAM reused
BL31 stays at EL3 for good: PSCI (CPU on/off, suspend, reboot) + i.MX SiP calls (DDR DVFS, CPU freq, power domains)
OP-TEE would stay at S-EL1, reached through BL31 (only when built in)
Addresses from this repo's build: CONFIG_SPL_TEXT_BASE, imx-atf BL31_BASE, CONFIG_TEXT_BASE; the kernel is moved to 0x4060_0000 by booti. OP-TEE address = imx-atf BL32_BASE default.
Dashed = optional stage, not part of the default build. Red arrows = transitions owned by the secure monitor.
